history.name: Font coverage read from the font files
history.description: The set of characters the bundled type can draw is generated by reading the character maps out of the font files themselves, and regenerated whenever a face is replaced. It is never maintained by hand, since a hand-kept list is exactly what goes quietly out of date and lets a missing character reach a finished document.
history.dev_notes: scripts/font-coverage.mjs parses the WOFF container and cmap formats 4 and 12 directly, writing assets/fonts/coverage.json.
